passages.title: Biography: Environmental Changemakers
passages.text: Maya Putri, a fictional student leader in this practice biography, noticed litter near the river in her town. In 2022, she invited five classmates to record the types of waste they found. They began monthly clean-ups and shared the results with residents. A year later, the team partnered with a local library to hold workshops about reusing materials. The workshops attracted more volunteers, but Maya reminded the team that keeping records mattered more than claiming instant success. Their reports helped the community plan new waste bins.
